offerings.name: Search (/search endpoint)
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up. Free: 1,000 credits/month; Hobby: $16/month billed annually for 5,000 credits; Standard: $83/month billed annually for 100,000 credits; Growth: $333/month billed annually for 500,000 credits; Scale: $599/month billed annually for 1,000,000 credits. Pay-as-you-go: $5 increments; credit quantity varies by plan.
offerings.price_basis: Credit-based pricing; Search 2 credits per 10 results. Pay-as-you-go rates range from 1,000 credits/$5 on Hobby to 5,000 credits/$5 on Scale.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required; pricing page states this covers 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，包含标题、描述和 URL；可选返回结果页面的 Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 1–10个结果收费2 credits，11–20个收费4 credits；启用抓取选项会另收页面费用。ZDR搜索为企业版：匿名2 credits/10结果，端到端10 credits/10结果。
